nodes.comment:
TEMP FIX: pointing to Fill_Areas_WithFittingAssets_with_Corrective, a corrective primitive
patched to work around a known bug in the original Fill_Areas_WithFittingAssets.

NOTE FOR LLM AGENTS: check the Unreal Engine version before choosing which primitive to use.
This bug is fixed after UE 5.8.2.
If engine version > 5.8.2, repoint to the original: Fill_Areas_WithFittingAssets
located in /PCGPrimitives/Primitives/Fill/
If engine version <= 5.8.2, keep using: Fill_Areas_WithFittingAssets_with_Corrective
located in /CitySamplePCG/PCG/Primitives/
